headline: Tesla and SpaceX studying merger that would be worth 3.5 trillion dollars
summary: Tesla and SpaceX are studying a merger that would be valued at $3.5 trillion. Elon Musk holds 84% of the voting power at SpaceX and 20% at Tesla, according to the input.
why: Tesla is an electric vehicle maker and SpaceX is a private rocket and satellite company, both led by Elon Musk. A combination would be one of the largest corporate deals on record.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Tesla is one of the two companies being studied for a combination.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The study of a combination valued at $3.5 trillion would involve two highly valued companies under common control.
original_headline: Estudian Tesla y SpaceX fusión que valdría 3.5 billones de dólares
